title: The Purity of All Things
english: Examine. All things indeed are pure to the pure (Titus 1:15). God has made all things pure; but if [things] are unclean, the accusation of the rejoicing creator touches [it]. And this is...
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG Fragmenta in epistulam ad Titum u01-rem-early

title: Acknowledgment vs Denial in Works
english: They confess to know God, but in works they deny [him].
He showed that he calls women to an inheritance (Tit 2:3); for he would not have said [they are] fit for priestly service (Tit 2:3).
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Intellect and Dignity in Work
english: He took hold of it through the intellect, but that which pertains to dignity is in the work, so that he might abstain not only from corruptible work but also from corruptible thought.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
